site.name: Eranga Perera
site.aboutHeading: Turning brands and business ideas into living visual stories.
site.aboutText: I’m Eranga Perera, a Sri Lankan creative designer working across brand identity, e-commerce campaigns, digital advertising and motion. With experience spanning agency, in-house and freelance projects, I bring ideas to life through purposeful design, clear visual systems and considered execution.
site.quoteHeading: I don’t just design. I shape how people see, feel and respond.
site.quoteText: Good creative work connects a clear idea with a strong visual point of view.
site.ctaText: Have a project in mind? Let’s talk about the idea, the audience and what you want to achieve.

faqs.q: What kind of projects do you take on?
faqs.a: Brand identity, campaign creative, e-commerce design, social and paid-ad creative, motion graphics and video editing.

faqs.q: Can you work with an existing brand?
faqs.a: Yes. I can work within an established identity system and help keep its visual communication consistent.
We begin with a short brief covering your objective, audience, deliverables and timeline. I’ll then recommend a practical creative direction.

faqs.q: Do you work with clients outside Sri Lanka?
faqs.a: Yes. Project requirements and communication can be handled remotely.
